subject: Demo recap + proposed pilot gateways, timeline & owner assignments
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novaedge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed pilot gateways, timeline & owner assignments

Ethan — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed pilot plan so we have a single source of truth for next steps. Attaching a short outline (novaedge-poc-outline.pdf) and a draft SOW for your procurement team to review.

High-level summary from the call:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference as the inference runtime for NovaEdge's internal summarization pipeline (5–10M tokens/day).
- Success criteria (proposed):
  1) 95th pctile latency <= 250ms for 512-token responses under production-like traffic.
  2) Token cost reduction >= 30% vs current baseline using batching + KV caching.
  3) End-to-end accuracy delta (ROUGE-L on our shared eval set) within +/- 2 points of baseline.
  4) Integration readiness: CI-friendly API and telemetry hooks in staging.

Proposed pilot structure (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (kickoff): Access, account setup, baseline sampling (owner: Marissa).
- Week 1–2 (integration + smoke): SDK integration, sample traffic replay, initial latency/cost profiling (owner: Ben).
- Week 3 (stress & tuning): Autoscale settings, batching profiles, quantization suggestions (owner: Ben).
- Week 4 (evaluation & handoff): Final metrics, runbook for production rollout, next-step proposal (owner: Lauren).

Operational gates (milestones where we agree to continue):
- Gate A (end of Week 1): Integration complete + baseline metrics collected.
- Gate B (end of Week 3): Latency and cost targets met or have accepted tradeoffs and mitigations.
- Gate C (end of Week 4): Exec sign-off to proceed to Dedicated capacity or production rollout.

What we need from you to proceed:
1) Confirm the success criteria above or send edits in-line.
2) Provide a staging account + a small sample of production traffic (anonymized) by Friday 4/23.
3) Loop in your procurement/legal contact so we can accelerate the SOW.

I've copied Ben to manage the technical onboarding and Lauren for commercial/POC acceptance. If this looks good I'll schedule the kickoff for Monday 4/26 at 10am PT.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: novaedge-poc-outline.pdf, redwood-sow-draft.docx

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novaedge.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@novaedge.ai>, Thomas Henderson <thomas.henderson@novaedge.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed pilot gateways, timeline & owner assignments

Marissa — appreciate the concise plan and the attachments. A few quick clarifications from our side after the call: 

1) Success criteria: the latency target looks reasonable; can we add a stability metric (error rate < 0.5% under 95th pctile load)?
2) Week 1 data: we can provision a staging bucket and share 48 hours of anonymized traffic by EOD Friday (4/23). Priya (copied) will coordinate the transfer.
3) Procurement: Tom is our procurement lead — he'll need the SOW and an initial quote for 4-week pilot + estimated monthly for Dedicated if we move forward.

Also — on integrations: our infra team prefers a short-lived API key + IAM-based access; is that supported for the staging pilot?

If you need alternatives for the kickoff time, we can shift to Tue 4/27 morning PT.

Thanks,
Ethan
Director of ML Systems | NovaEdge
ethan.cole@novaedge.ai

Ethan, thanks — quick answers and next steps from the engineering onboarding perspective.

- IAM/API keys: Yes, we can provision scoped, short-lived API credentials for the staging pilot. We'll provide a small onboarding script to rotate keys during the pilot.
- Stability metric: happy to add error rate < 0.5% to Gate B. We'll instrument both client and server side traces so we can correlate.
- Work plan update: I updated the attached outline to include the access checklist and telemetry schema (see novaedge-poc-outline.pdf).

Action items I will take:
- Create staging credentials and share with Ethan + Priya by Friday 4/23 EOD (Ben).
- Upload a sample telemetry dashboard to the shared Drive link by Monday 4/26 (Ben).
- Run a small-scale smoke test within 48 hours of receiving the anonymized traffic and report back.

If we get the traffic dump Friday and keys the same day we can still hit a Monday 4/26 kickoff; otherwise Tue 4/27 is our fallback.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@novaedge.ai>

Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novaedge.ai>, Thomas Henderson <thomas.henderson@novaedge.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed pilot gateways, timeline & owner assignments

Hi all — thanks for the plan. Tom and I reviewed the draft SOW and have two procurement questions before we can sign the pilot SOW: 

1) Data handling: confirm that Redwood will not persist raw customer payloads beyond transient caching for the pilot and that any logs/snapshots we share will be treated per the NDA. We need a short clause in the SOW reflecting this.
2) Billing: can you provide an estimated pilot quote (noting the baseline and overage terms)? Tom will need that to generate an internal PR.

We'll prepare the anonymized traffic export today and share the Drive link. Once we have the SOW clause and a pilot estimate we can commit to the kickoff date.

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Head of Procurement | NovaEdge
priya.rao@novaedge.ai
